description: Upscale a video to 4K at 30 frames per second with added detail. Up to 10 seconds per call. Compared with other video tools: mid-priced. Price: from $0.108 per second (one call: from $0.541 per video), charged only on success. Price depends on max_seconds: 5 $0.541, 10 $1.081 (default 5). With an account API key you pay only for what the call used (per second), never more than this price. One call = one short video.

max_seconds.description: Longest the video can be; sets the price. Longer videos are refused before anything runs, and not charged. Default 5

video.description: Video to upscale as an MP4 link (https), up to 10 seconds. Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

name: video-upscale-4k
title: Video upscaler to 4K
